2346:     (quotientMap M N).ker = (Phi M N).range := by

2348:     (QuotientAddGroup.ker_mk' (Phi M N).range)

2350: /-- The canonical quotient map annihilates the comparison map. -/
2351: theorem quotientMap_comp_Phi_eq_zero (M N : ℕ) :
2352:     (quotientMap M N).comp (Phi M N) = 0 := by
2353:   apply AddMonoidHom.ext
2354:   intro z
2355:   change quotientMap M N (Phi M N z) = 0
2356:   apply AddMonoidHom.mem_ker.mp
2357:   rw [quotientMap_ker]
2358:   exact AddMonoidHom.mem_range.mpr ⟨z, rfl⟩

2413: /-- The homomorphism on the actual cokernel induced by `psi`. -/

2415:     PhiCokernel M N →+ ZMod (Nat.gcd M N) :=
2416:   desc M N (psi M N) (psi_comp_Phi_eq_zero M N)

2431: /-- First-isomorphism-theorem equivalence from the actual cokernel to the gcd
2432: residue group.  It is noncomputable only because Mathlib chooses an inverse to
2433: the proved surjection `psi`. -/
2434: noncomputable def equivZMod (M N : ℕ) :

2458:     (equivZMod M N).toAddMonoidHom.comp (quotientMap M N)

2545: /-- Auditable certificate for the actual quotient and induced isomorphism. -/
2546: structure Certificate (M N : ℕ) : Prop where
2547:   quotient_surjective : Function.Surjective (quotientMap M N)
2548:   quotient_kernel : (quotientMap M N).ker = (Phi M N).range
2549:   quotient_composite_zero : (quotientMap M N).comp (Phi M N) = 0
2550:   quotient_universal :
2551:     ∀ {A : Type*} [AddCommGroup A]
2552:       (f : ZMod M × ZMod N →+ A) (hf : f.comp (Phi M N) = 0),
2553:       ∃! g : PhiCokernel M N →+ A,
2554:         g.comp (quotientMap M N) = f
2555:   psi_descends : (descPsi M N).comp (quotientMap M N) = psi M N
2556:   quotient_residue_exact : (atResidueProduct M N).Exact
2557:   quotient_right_exact : (rightEndpoint M N).Exact
2558:   quotient_equiv_gcd :
2559:     Nonempty (PhiCokernel M N ≃+ ZMod (Nat.gcd M N))
2560:   quotient_sequence_iso :
2561:     Nonempty (atResidueProduct M N ≅
2562:       Prop21StandardSequence.atResidueProduct M N)
2563:   equivalence_is_induced :
2564:     (equivZMod M N).toAddMonoidHom.comp (quotientMap M N) = psi M N
2565:   categorical_triangle :
2566:     quotientMorphism M N ≫ (gcdIso M N).hom =
2567:       Prop21StandardSequence.difference M N
2568: 
2569: theorem certificate (M N : ℕ) : Certificate M N := by
2570:   exact
2571:     { quotient_surjective := quotientMap_surjective M N
2572:       quotient_kernel := quotientMap_ker M N
2573:       quotient_composite_zero := quotientMap_comp_Phi_eq_zero M N
2574:       quotient_universal := existsUnique_desc M N
2575:       psi_descends := descPsi_comp_quotientMap M N
2576:       quotient_residue_exact := atResidueProduct_exact M N
2577:       quotient_right_exact := rightEndpoint_exact M N
2578:       quotient_equiv_gcd := ⟨equivZMod M N⟩
2579:       quotient_sequence_iso := ⟨atResidueProductIso M N⟩
2580:       equivalence_is_induced :=
2581:         equivZMod_toAddMonoidHom_comp_quotientMap M N
2582:       categorical_triangle := quotientMorphism_comp_gcdIso_hom M N }
2583: 
2584: end PhiCokernel

16314: /-- Closed-carrier compact-preimage properness is sufficient for the exact
16315: literal `F_Y` tail statement.  This reduction uses the already-proved theorem
16316: that every compact subset of the closed carrier lies in one three-cusp
16317: truncation; no boundary or Stokes assertion is used. -/
16318: theorem gammaTwoQuotientCompactFluxTailTightness_of_closedCarrierCompactPreimage
16319:     (hProper : GammaTwoClosedCarrierCompactPreimage) :
16320:     GammaTwoQuotientCompactFluxTailTightness := by
16321:   intro X Y hXY
16322:   rcases hXY with ⟨_hXs, _hYs, hXc, hYc, _hInv⟩
16323:   let K : Set GammaTwoQuotient := quotientTSupport X ∪ quotientTSupport Y
16324:   have hK : IsCompact K := hXc.union hYc
16325:   have hLift : IsCompact
16326:       (gammaTwoClosedTileCarrier ∩ gammaTwoQuotientMk ⁻¹' K) :=
16327:     hProper K hK
16328:   obtain ⟨Y₀, hY₀, hsub⟩ :=
16329:     compact_closedTileCarrier_subset_threeCuspTruncation hLift
16330:       Set.inter_subset_left
16331:   refine ⟨Y₀, hY₀, ?_⟩
16332:   intro z hz
16333:   constructor
16334:   · by_contra hXz
16335:     have hqX : gammaTwoQuotientMk z ∈ quotientTSupport X :=
16336:       subset_closure ⟨z, hXz, rfl⟩
16337:     have hzLift : z ∈
16338:         gammaTwoClosedTileCarrier ∩ gammaTwoQuotientMk ⁻¹' K :=
16339:       ⟨hz.1, Or.inl hqX⟩
16340:     exact hz.2 (hsub hzLift)
16341:   · by_contra hYz

16343:       subset_closure ⟨z, hYz, rfl⟩
16344:     have hzLift : z ∈
16345:         gammaTwoClosedTileCarrier ∩ gammaTwoQuotientMk ⁻¹' K :=
16346:       ⟨hz.1, Or.inr hqY⟩
16347:     exact hz.2 (hsub hzLift)

20350: /-- Projecting the upstairs cutoff support gives exactly the support of the
20351: descended cutoff.  This prevents any hidden choice of quotient
20352: representatives in the compact-support proof. -/
20353: theorem upstairsCoreCutoff_projected_support :
20354:     gammaTwoQuotientMk '' Function.support upstairsCoreCutoff =
20355:       Function.support quotientCoreCutoff := by
20356:   ext q

20360:   · rintro ⟨w, hw, hEq⟩

20362:       simpa only [Function.mem_support, quotientCoreCutoff_mk] using hw
20363:     rwa [hEq] at hw'
20364:   · intro hz
20365:     refine ⟨z, ?_, rfl⟩
20366:     change quotientCoreCutoff (gammaTwoQuotientMk z) ≠ 0 at hz
20367:     rw [quotientCoreCutoff_mk] at hz
20368:     exact hz

33063: 
33064: /-!
33065: # P2.1--P2.2 concrete `Gamma(2)` cusp-geometry facade
33066: 
33067: This file is deliberately a thin facade over the unconditional geometry in
33068: `Mock2FA.PaperCorrections.AutomorphicSobolev.GammaTwoQuotientGeometry` and the
33069: proved compact-flux tail theorem in
33070: `GammaTwoQuotientGreenBoundary`.  It does not replace those proofs by new
33071: hypotheses and it does not promote the still-missing oriented polygonal
33072: Stokes theorem to a certificate.
33073: 
33074: The original arithmetic action has the central kernel `±1`.  Consequently
33075: the quotient used below is formed with the faithful permutation image of
33076: `Gamma(2)`.  This changes no orbit.  Compact-preimage properness is asserted
33077: only after intersecting with the selected closed six-tile carrier; the
33078: strictly stronger raw full-preimage statement is named at the end of this
33079: file, but is intentionally not inhabited or included in the certificate.
33080: -/
33081:

33599: 
33600: /-- The intrinsic closed cusp truncation as a subset of the effective orbit
33601: quotient.  Membership means that the orbit has at least one representative in
33602: the literal closed-polygon stage. -/
33603: def XSet (Y : ℝ) : Set GammaTwoQuotient :=
33604:   gammaTwoQuotientMk '' gammaTwoThreeCuspTruncation Y
33605: 
33606: /-- The intrinsic truncated quotient, equipped with the subtype topology and
33607: the subtype measurable space inherited from `GammaTwoQuotient`. -/
33608: abbrev X (Y : ℝ) : Type :=
33609:   XSet Y
33610: 
33611: /-- Membership in `XSet Y` is exactly existence of a representative in the
33612: literal upstairs stage.  This formulation contains no selected quotient
33613: representative. -/
33614: theorem mem_XSet_iff_exists_representative (Y : ℝ)
33615:     (x : GammaTwoQuotient) :
33616:     x ∈ XSet Y ↔
33617:       ∃ z : ℍ, z ∈ gammaTwoThreeCuspTruncation Y ∧
33618:         gammaTwoQuotientMk z = x := by
33619:   rfl
33620: 
33621: /-- Representative-level version of `mem_XSet_iff_exists_representative`.
33622: It deliberately does *not* claim that the chosen representative `z` itself
33623: lies in the closed polygon. -/
33624: theorem quotientMk_mem_XSet_iff_exists_representative (Y : ℝ) (z : ℍ) :
33625:     gammaTwoQuotientMk z ∈ XSet Y ↔
33626:       ∃ w : ℍ, w ∈ gammaTwoThreeCuspTruncation Y ∧
33627:         gammaTwoQuotientMk w = gammaTwoQuotientMk z :=
33628:   mem_XSet_iff_exists_representative Y (gammaTwoQuotientMk z)
33629: 
33630: /-- Every point of the literal upstairs stage projects to the intrinsic
33631: stage. -/
33632: theorem quotientMk_mem_XSet_of_mem (Y : ℝ) {z : ℍ}
33633:     (hz : z ∈ gammaTwoThreeCuspTruncation Y) :
33634:     gammaTwoQuotientMk z ∈ XSet Y :=
33635:   ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
33636: 
33637: /-- Membership is independent of the chosen upper-half-plane representative,
33638: expressed for arbitrary representatives with equal quotient classes. -/
33639: theorem quotientMk_mem_XSet_congr (Y : ℝ) {z w : ℍ}
33640:     (hzw : gammaTwoQuotientMk z = gammaTwoQuotientMk w) :
33641:     gammaTwoQuotientMk z ∈ XSet Y ↔
33642:       gammaTwoQuotientMk w ∈ XSet Y := by
33643:   rw [hzw]
33644: 
33645: /-- Membership is unchanged by every effective deck transformation. -/
33646: @[simp]
33647: theorem quotientMk_smul_mem_XSet_iff (Y : ℝ)
33648:     (g : GammaTwoEffective) (z : ℍ) :
33649:     gammaTwoQuotientMk (g • z) ∈ XSet Y ↔
33650:       gammaTwoQuotientMk z ∈ XSet Y := by
33651:   rw [gammaTwoQuotientMk_smul]
33652: 
33653: /-- The same representative-independence statement for the original
33654: `Gamma(2)` matrix action. -/
33655: @[simp]
33656: theorem quotientMk_gamma_smul_mem_XSet_iff (Y : ℝ)
33657:     (gamma : GammaTwo) (z : ℍ) :
33658:     gammaTwoQuotientMk (gamma • z) ∈ XSet Y ↔
33659:       gammaTwoQuotientMk z ∈ XSet Y := by
33660:   rw [gammaTwoQuotientMk_gamma_smul]
33661: 
33662: /-- The full inverse image of the intrinsic stage is the orbit saturation of
33663: the literal polygon stage.  This is the precise replacement for the false
33664: statement `z ∈ F_Y ↔ quotientMk z ∈ X_Y`. -/
33665: theorem preimage_XSet_eq_saturation (Y : ℝ) :
33666:     gammaTwoQuotientMk ⁻¹' XSet Y =
33667:       ⋃ g : GammaTwoEffective,
33668:         (g • ·) '' gammaTwoThreeCuspTruncation Y := by

33670:     (Quotient.mk'' : ℍ → GammaTwoQuotient) ⁻¹'
33671:         ((Quotient.mk'' : ℍ → GammaTwoQuotient) ''
33672:           gammaTwoThreeCuspTruncation Y) =
33673:       ⋃ g : GammaTwoEffective,
33674:         (g • ·) '' gammaTwoThreeCuspTruncation Y
33675:   exact MulAction.quotient_preimage_image_eq_union_mul
33676:     (gammaTwoThreeCuspTruncation Y) (G := GammaTwoEffective)
33677: 
33678: /-- For the open orbit projection, a quotient point is interior to the
33679: intrinsic stage exactly when any chosen representative is interior to its
33680: full saturated inverse image.  This is the precise topological reduction of
33681: the paired-side interior problem. -/
33682: theorem quotientMk_mem_interior_XSet_iff (Y : ℝ) (z : ℍ) :
33683:     gammaTwoQuotientMk z ∈ interior (XSet Y) ↔
33684:       z ∈ interior (gammaTwoQuotientMk ⁻¹' XSet Y) := by
33685:   constructor
33686:   · intro hz
33687:     exact
33688:       (interior_maximal
33689:         (Set.preimage_mono interior_subset)
33690:         (isOpen_interior.preimage
33691:           gammaTwoQuotientMk_isOpenQuotientMap.continuous)) hz
33692:   · intro hz
33693:     let U : Set ℍ := interior (gammaTwoQuotientMk ⁻¹' XSet Y)
33694:     have hUOpen : IsOpen U := isOpen_interior
33695:     have hImageOpen : IsOpen (gammaTwoQuotientMk '' U) :=
33696:       gammaTwoQuotientMk_isOpenQuotientMap.isOpenMap U hUOpen
33697:     have hImageSubset : gammaTwoQuotientMk '' U ⊆ XSet Y := by
33698:       rintro x ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
33699:       change w ∈ gammaTwoQuotientMk ⁻¹' XSet Y
33700:       exact interior_subset hw
33701:     exact (interior_maximal hImageSubset hImageOpen)
33702:       ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
33703: 
33704: /-- Interior membership expressed entirely in the explicit union of deck
33705: translates of the literal polygon stage.  A local two-tile filling theorem
33706: for paired sides can target the right-hand side without choosing a quotient
33707: section. -/
33708: theorem quotientMk_mem_interior_XSet_iff_saturation
33709:     (Y : ℝ) (z : ℍ) :
33710:     gammaTwoQuotientMk z ∈ interior (XSet Y) ↔
33711:       z ∈ interior
33712:         (⋃ g : GammaTwoEffective,
33713:           (g • ·) '' gammaTwoThreeCuspTruncation Y) := by
33714:   rw [quotientMk_mem_interior_XSet_iff,
33715:     preimage_XSet_eq_saturation]
